“O Mother! You cry out ‘I live’ in the forest;
All those named Jīva have been burned in this cremation ground;
whom among them do you grieve for?
“Truly, the arrow has been pulled out from my heart—
that arrow so difficult to see—
which was lodged there while I was overcome by grief.”
She has dispelled her grief for her daughter.
she is free from craving and has attained final Nibbāna.
“I go for refuge to the Buddha, the Dhamma, and the Saṅgha— to the Sage.
… Thus spoke the Elder Nun Ubbirī.
